But the old flash drive doesn't work anymore, so you'll have to find a new one, reflash the transmitter, and give it to me. I'll update your transmitter properly.}} ==Objectives== * Obtain the [[Secure Flash drive V3|V3 Flash drive]] on [[Lighthouse]] * Reflash the [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|Radio transmitter]] * Hand over the [[Secure Flash drive V3|flash drive]] to [[Mechanic]] * Visit the lighthouse building ==Rewards== * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.01''' {{quote|Hope all this mess doesn't happen again.}} ==Failure Penalty== * Mechanic Rep '''-0.02''' ==Guide== By killing [[Zryachiy]] you will fail and lose access to this quest. {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:V3FlashIcon.png|link=Secure Flash drive V3]] |[[Secure Flash drive V3]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |''This [[Quests#Quest items|quest item]] can only be found if the quest is active.''
''When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.''
''If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.'' |- ![[File:Rogue USEC Barrack key icon.png|link=Rogue USEC barrack key]] |[[Rogue USEC barrack key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |Unlocks a room in building #3. |- ![[File:WTP Store Icon.png|link=Water treatment plant storage room key]] |[[Water treatment plant storage room key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |Unlocks a storage room in building #2. |} '''*'''Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. There are multiple spawns for the [[Secure Flash drive V3|V3 flash drive]] at the water treatment plant on [[Lighthouse]]. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|transmitter]] at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the [[Hideout]]. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]] and [[Zryachiy]] guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet [[Lightkeeper]].
